title: Six pairs of shoes and seven months on the Pacific Crest Trail took Nancy Zelick from Mexico to Canada

posts.facebook:
Nancy Zelick retired from Intel, then walked the Pacific Crest Trail from Mexico to Canada. Slowly, on purpose.

How a retired Intel researcher from Baker City, Oregon, walked the Pacific Crest Trail from Mexico to Canada in about seven months: the snow, the gear, the food and why she thinks pace mattered more than youth. How to start multi-day hiking, or build towards a long trail if you already walk.

On a long walk, going slowly is not a weakness: it is how you reach the end.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/explore/nancy-zelick-pacific-crest-trail/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
